info.title: Sessionboard Public API
info.description: REST API for managing sessions, speakers, contacts, sponsors, exhibitors, and event data on the Sessionboard platform.

tags.name: Awards
tags.description: Read and manage Awards programs and their categories, rounds, promo codes, submissions and reviews. Organization-level: paths start at `/v1/organization/{orgId}/awards`. Requires `read:awards` / `write:awards` scopes.

ApiKey.name: x-access-token
ApiKey.description: Organization API token. Generate from Organization Settings → API Tokens.

BearerToken.description: OAuth 2.1 access token. Obtained via the OAuth PKCE flow at `/oauth/token`.

AwardsOrgId.name: orgId
AwardsOrgId.description: Your organization ID. Any other organization returns `404`.

AwardsPageSize.name: pageSize
AwardsPageSize.description: Results per page. `page_size` is also accepted.

AwardsForce.name: force
AwardsForce.description: Delete even though the record is in use (see the `409` response).

slug.description: Defaults to one derived from `name` on create.

default_submission_status.description: Status a new submission starts in. Empty string or `null` clears it.

parent_category_id.description: Another category in the same program. `null` makes it top-level.

submission_limit.description: Most submissions one submitter may file in this category.

is_default.description: The program's first round. It cannot be deleted.

redemption_count.description: Submissions the code has been applied to. Returned by the single-code GET only.

amount.description: Percent off (at most 100) or a flat amount in the program's currency.

values.description: Form answers keyed by form field ID. Returned by the single-submission GET and by updates.
Answers keyed by form field ID. Fields you omit are left unchanged; a required field sent empty returns `400`.

allow_submitter_editing_override.description: Let this submitter edit regardless of the program's editing policy. `null` clears the override.

value.description: Number, text, or JSON depending on the scorecard field.

ListPagination.description: Pagination metadata returned by the event-settings GET lists (tags, tracks, levels, formats, rooms, languages, statuses). Same numbers as `Pagination`, snake_case keys — these endpoints are served by a different layer, and the casing is longstanding.
